title: The Royal Capital
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue:
A vast gothic city glows beneath a full moon.
In this world, kings rule more than kingdoms. They rule blood.

title: The Forgotten
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue:
There was a young man whose body remembers a past his mind has forgotten.
Every time certain people, places, or events appear... he feels a pain he cannot explain.

title: Shadows of the Past
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue:
Faces he has never met feel familiar.
Places he has never been feel like home.
And memories that should be empty... hurt.

title: A Question Without Answers
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue:
He doesn't know who he is.
He doesn't know who did this to him.
But he knows one thing... he will find the truth.

title: The Wolf Awakens
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue:
In the shadows of this world, something ancient stirs.
A wolf that should have been forgotten...
And a king who is not yet ready for what is coming.

title: Morning in Veylreach
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue: The next morning, Setsuna returns to the lower city. He remembers the pain, not the memory.

title: The Bread Seller
speaker: Vendor
dialogue: You're back already?

title: Small Habits
speaker: Setsuna
dialogue: You overcharge everyone.

title: A Smile
speaker: Vendor
dialogue: And somehow you still come back.

title: An Empty Answer
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue:
Setsuna has routines. He has instincts.
What he does not have is a past.

title: Royal Banners
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue: Today the capital prepares for the King's procession.

title: The King's Road
speaker: Crowd
dialogue: Make way!

title: A Familiar Crest
speaker: Setsuna
dialogue: That symbol...

title: The Pain Returns
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue:
The crest should mean nothing to him.
Instead, his scar burns.

title: The Woman in Black
speaker: Lyra
dialogue: Are you hurt?

title: The First Look
speaker: Setsuna
dialogue: Do I know you?

title: A Careful Lie
speaker: Lyra
dialogue: No.

title: The Wrong Answer
speaker: Setsuna
dialogue: You answered too quickly.

title: Lyra Veyne
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue: Lyra Veyne carries a sealed royal document and a secret she was ordered not to reveal.

title: The Question
speaker: Lyra
dialogue: What do you remember?

title: The Truth
speaker: Setsuna
dialogue: Nothing I can trust.

title: A Warning
speaker: Lyra
dialogue: Then don't trust the people who say they remember for you.

title: The Knight
speaker: Kael
dialogue: Step away from her.

title: Kael Draven
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue: A royal knight. Young enough to be underestimated. Experienced enough not to care.

title: The Crest
speaker: Kael
dialogue: You shouldn't be wearing that face near the King's road.

title: Setsuna Pushes Back
speaker: Setsuna
dialogue: I only have one face.

title: A Dangerous Joke
speaker: Kael
dialogue: That's not what I meant.

title: Three Watchers
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue:
Three people are watching.
Lyra knows two of them.
Kael knows all three.

title: The Strategist
speaker: Riven
dialogue: Confirm the eye.

title: The Report
speaker: Guard
dialogue: The scar is real, sir.

title: Solene Aria
speaker: Solene
dialogue: If that is Setsuna... the Ashen Kingdom wasn't destroyed completely.

title: A Name From Nowhere
speaker: Setsuna
dialogue: Ashen...

title: The Pain
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue: The name hits like a blade.

title: Memory Fragment
speaker: Unknown Voice
dialogue: Don't look back.

title: Fire
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue:
Stone towers collapse.
A throne burns.
Someone is running.

title: The Hand
speaker: Young Setsuna
dialogue: Who are you?

title: The Answer
speaker: Unknown Voice
dialogue: Someone who promised to protect you.

title: Back to Veylreach
speaker: Setsuna
dialogue: That's impossible.

title: Following Lyra
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue: Setsuna follows Lyra into a narrow side street.

title: The Alley
speaker: Lyra
dialogue: You should not have followed me.

title: Teleportation
speaker: Setsuna
dialogue: Then you shouldn't have disappeared.

title: The Hunter
speaker: Masked Fighter
dialogue: You were supposed to stay forgotten.

title: The Strike
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue: The attacker moves with a supernatural technique Setsuna has never seen.

title: The Crimson Eye
speaker: Setsuna
dialogue: What... is happening to my eye?

title: The Copy
speaker: Masked Fighter
dialogue: You copied my ability.

title: The Escape
speaker: Kael
dialogue: Stop!

title: The Wolf
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue: Far above the city, a black wolf opens its eyes.

title: Remember
speaker: Wolf
dialogue: Remember.

title: The Choice
speaker: Setsuna
dialogue: If my past is looking for me... I'll meet it.

title: The Beginning
speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue:
Someone is watching.
Someone is waiting.
And before the truth can be buried again, Setsuna will have to decide what he is willing to lose.
The journey has begun.
